programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。

programme.title: Behave
programme.desc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。

programme.title: 封門村驚魂
programme.desc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭

programme.title: 看不見的他們
programme.desc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 血芙蓉
programme.desc: 故事描述清帝雍正為了鞏固統治地位,組織了一暗殺集團「血滴子」,為他殺害異見分子。時有一清廷侍衛統領韓天德者,因不值雍正所為而遭殺害,幸其妻容秋燕適不在家,幸免於難,容悲憤莫名,獨闖「血滴子」統領金罡風家,為夫報仇,終行刺失敗而回。後得棄暗投明之前「血滴子」成員馬騰及其師弟王俊相助,合三人之力終將金罡

programme.title: 獨臂刀王
programme.desc: 獨臂刀方剛與妻子二人息隱歸田,但當方剛的妻子被擄走,他唯有被迫重出江湖對付武林惡黨「八大刀王」,以救回妻子。

programme.title: 花月良宵
programme.desc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。

programme.title: 唐山五虎
programme.desc: 一位功夫師傅與三位門徒被惡霸欺淩,師徒俱敗於他拳下。三徒悲憤填膺,分別尋師學藝。半年後,惡霸壽辰之日,三徒連袂回歸,誓要與惡霸一較高下!

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。

programme.title: 七俠五義
programme.desc: 太師之子在陳州貪贓枉法,私吞皇糧,被包拯當場斬首處死。太師知道後大怒,並令人刺殺包拯,幸得展昭及時阻止,救回他一命。皇上的珍品被偷的同時,宮中又發生謀殺案,於是,皇上限定包拯要在十天內破案。展昭馬上出發搜捕兇手。包拯和展昭最後可否如期破案?

programme.title: 阿牛入城記
programme.desc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?

programme.title: 天下第一劍
programme.desc: 南劍丁夢豪是「天下第一劍」,卻敗於路過的怪和尚。丁履行諾言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修煉期滿返回家鄉後,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他決戰,唯丁欲隱居民間,所以堅拒一切挑戰。無奈後來卻要被逼與北劍再來一場生死決鬥,究竟最後會是鹿死誰手?

programme.title: 艷陽天
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛,常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人,得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出,心卻惦念燕南,一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執,怎料汽車失事

programme.title: 琴劍恩仇
programme.desc: 桂武和甘聯珠夫婦共闖江湖、報恩仇,得女俠紅姑之助,技藝大進,博得鴛鴦劍俠美名;桂甘今受紅姑所托,將殺人利器「鳳琴」送往家中;誰料途經飛虎寨,不慎以「鳳琴」射傷少寨主,當夜琴亦為神偷盜去

programme.title: 風流韻事
programme.desc: 本片講述了三個故事。《蕭翼賺蘭亭》講述唐太宗李世民收盡天下王羲之的書法,獨缺《蘭亭序》,御史蕭翼多才多藝,設計從辯才和尚那裡騙取《蘭亭序》《蕙蓮》以林偉圖設計謀殺李鵬飛為序幕,以李在橋上看奇書《金瓶梅》展開劇情;而《小神仙》則又由偷牛、捉姦和小神仙同藥師之間的鬥法三個小故事組成。

programme.title: 龍虎溝
programme.desc: 本片為導演岳楓於1966年執導之民初動作片,劇情主要描述,二妞收到父親遇害前寫下的仇人名單,遂連同兄長建明展開一幕奇情追凶…

programme.title: 瘋猴
programme.desc: 陳百精通「猴拳」,但卻被惡霸設計陷害,更廢了他雙手。陳百終淪落為流浪藝人,直到遇上街頭小子小侯,決將一身「猴拳」,傾囊相授。最後師徒二人聯手,勢要一雪前恥。

programme.title: 街市英雄
programme.desc: 本片講述洪熙官被投靠清廷之武林敗類高進忠追殺,身受重傷,市井英雄朱才、陳阿全、梁天寶安排洪藏身於豆腐店中,並為他買藥治傷。高進忠探得洪藏身之處,暗囑手下廣佈眼線,以便將洪一舉成擒

programme.title: 街市英雄
programme.desc: 本片講述洪熙官被投靠清廷之武林敗類高進忠追殺,身受重傷,市井英雄朱才、陳阿全、梁天寶安排洪藏身於豆腐店中,並為他買藥治傷。高進忠探得洪藏身之處,暗囑手下廣佈眼線,以便將洪一舉成擒

programme.title: 小毒龍
programme.desc: 故事描述,江湖出現一貧僧打扮名喚小毒龍之殺手,嫉惡如仇,專殺江湖敗類。她乃大悲寺瘋僧之門徒,亦即「毒龍劍」的傳人李寶珠;她獨來獨往神出鬼沒,歹徒聞風喪膽。她身背父仇,待中秋與仇人在十字坡一決生死。陳仕倫為李之表哥,乃鐵扇子之高徒,率十字坡鄉民嚴陣以待,助李抗敵…

programme.title: 邪完再邪
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素,欲與其結合,央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親,撮合一段人鬼姻緣,馬素年青憨直,不願與鬼為伍,堅決拒絕,實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜,阿翠洞悉其情,決定伺機行動。

programme.title: 金印仇
programme.desc: 戴天仇自幼習武,矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人,到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕,並突遭多名幫會中人毒打,吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤,希望可乘機報仇

programme.title: 人皮燈籠
programme.desc: 趙春方曾於決鬥敗於龍帥之手下。七年後,龍帥為在賞燈大會上奪魁,往尋趙春方代為製造別緻燈籠。趙春方藉此暗中佈下復仇大計。龍帥之妻無固失蹤後,他驚聞有關人皮燈籠的傳說,並開始懷疑趙春方與失蹤事件有關

programme.title: 沖霄樓
programme.desc: 改編自俠義小說《七俠五義》,人物繁多,情節多變,難得張徹處理得有條不紊,角色性格分明。故事講述襄陽王在王府中,建造的沖霄樓機關密佈,又廣招花蝴蝶花沖、神手大聖鄧車和小諸葛沈仲元等江湖俠士加盟,伺機造反。包公得悉襄陽王叛跡,乃命門生顏春敏前往調查。

programme.title: 青春戀
programme.desc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。

programme.title: 少林搭棚大師
programme.desc: 本片是少林三部作的第二部,講述劉家輝飾演的周仁傑一心要去少林寺學功夫,最後竟扮成寺中的三德和尚,並創出「搭棚式」的少林武藝。

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…

programme.title: 江湖子弟
programme.desc: 涉世未深的劉大江與結拜兄弟因劫金事件反目成仇,慘遭離間追殺,僥倖撿回一命後淪為打劫賭檔的小混混,卻獲歐陽幫主賞識。在女保鏢金燕協助下展開復仇,而黑旗門遺孀張玫瑰也因暗生情愫而對他網開一面。幾方勢力在幫派恩怨與愛恨糾葛中激烈角力,最終引爆一場江湖浩劫。

programme.title: 82家房客
programme.desc: 延續經典喜劇《72家房客》的成功,本片講述一羣住在香港唐樓的租客被發展商強行迫遷的故事。有些租客願意接受金錢賠償,但有些卻堅決反對。收購計劃最終又會否破壞鄰里間的和諧?

programme.title: 鐵旗門
programme.desc: 正派「鐵旗門」與反派「神鷹堂」,一直對立。一次,「神鷹堂」堂主以向「鐵旗門」陪罪為辭,邀「鐵旗門」門主鐵麟偕弟子往總壇喝酒;鐵認為內中有詐,不宜前往,但大弟子曹風則力言將計就計,若彼等有所行動,就乘機將他們消滅,鐵允之。「神鷹堂」果然十面埋伏,鐵等將敵人逐一殲滅;惟鐵竟在混亂中遇害,卻未知死於誰手…

programme.title: 春暖花開
programme.desc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…

programme.title: 少林英雄榜
programme.desc: 少林寺主持安排至善禪師前往武當道長處,學習獨特的功夫技能。在路途中,他遭遇了清兵與明軍之間的激烈鬥爭,同時還需召集少林弟子重建被燒毀的少林寺。

programme.title: 女俠賣人頭
programme.desc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛,其父花振芳去說親,卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿,找上駱家,把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句,萬率眾圍殺碧蓮,幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後,重金收買知府,將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監,見宏勛奄奄一息,遂隻身闖進王倫練武場,大戰眾強徒,並取下王倫助手首

programme.title: 女俠賣人頭
programme.desc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛,其父花振芳去說親,卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿,找上駱家,把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句,萬率眾圍殺碧蓮,幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後,重金收買知府,將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監,見宏勛奄奄一息,遂隻身闖進王倫練武場,大戰眾強徒,並取下王倫助手首

programme.title: 金衣大俠
programme.desc: 故事講述女俠俞飛霞,被武林盟主誤會她是运用「黑沙掌」,偷去神功寶書的幪面少女。於是她女扮男裝,混入少林寺暗中查探真相

programme.title: 雙喜臨門
programme.desc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚。此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門。

programme.title: 飛狐外傳
programme.desc: 十八年前,胡斐之父胡一刀,與苗人鳳交換刀劍比武,被己刀傷,繼而身亡,原來胡之刀早被田歸農塗上毒藥;苗妻南蘭被田勾引,竟拋夫棄女,后田更以毒粉弄瞎苗雙眼;斐見苗受此遭遇,決定代其向藥王求救,亦因此碰上一生中最愛的藥王傳人程靈素……

programme.title: 白蛇傳
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙,後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散

programme.title: 通天小子紅槍客
programme.desc: 通天少爺李寶通乃棉胎店老闆李昌建之獨子,平素不服父親管教外,還經常整蠱作怪;古板嚴謹的李昌建,屢遭兒子作弄亦不自知。寶通經常暗中替喬裝乞丐的偵緝隊長陳英剛買食物,並向他學習武功;後英剛給「紅槍客」林飛殺死,寶通正好在暗處看見事發經過,並偷聽到林飛所透露的犯案者名字。此時,寶通行蹤被發現,幸寶通機智,

programme.title: 宋宮秘史
programme.desc: 包公發現劉妃在二十年前為保其位而謀害李妃,將李妃剛誕下的兒子調走後,把她逐出皇宮。於是,包公用妙計誘大太監郭槐認罪,揭發當年他與劉妃合謀陷害李妃之奸計,並將劉妃定罪。而李妃也被接回皇宮,與已為皇帝的兒子團聚。

programme.title: 童子功
programme.desc: 武功秘笈《童子功》原掌握在正義武林人士的手中,江湖異人龍無天盜去前三招,龍為實現稱霸江湖的野心,決心要將那本武功秘笈的所有招式弄到手。他率領一群爪牙四處掠索,橫行江湖。浪俠及甘素凡二位青年,抱著為師復仇、為民除害的決心,各自苦練武功,分別跟蹤龍無天,歷經數劫,師兄妹兩人終於重逢相認,並肩作戰

programme.title: 金玉良緣紅樓夢
programme.desc: 根據中國古典文學巨著紅樓夢改編。賈寶玉出身京城中的名門望族賈府,與表妹林黛玉彼此相戀。可惜他們的戀情為賈母所不容,更使計瞞騙寶玉另娶一富家女,結果令寶玉和黛玉這對金童玉女落入悲慘的下場。

programme.title: 陸阿采與黃飛鴻
programme.desc: 年輕的黃飛鴻誓要證明自己有能力,可以成為父親的習武師傅陸阿采的徒弟。雖然他在一次比武中落敗,但黃飛鴻對武學的熱誠終於感動了陸阿采,並得償所願拜他為師。

programme.title: 天使出更
programme.desc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題,原來該院院長體弱多病,院務交陳醫生主理;但陳個性主觀,行事不依規章,連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」,時鬧笑話,弄至院務混亂。院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革

programme.title: 玉羅剎
programme.desc: 故事描述,每逢恐怖歌聲出現,必有閻家的人被署名「玉羅剎」者所殺。由於「玉羅剎」神出鬼沒,鬧得滿城風雨。冷秋寒于酒館遇見徐英豪,交談下,知彼也為尋仇而來;冷直告自己實為「玉羅剎」,殺閻家為替全家報仇,徐勸其勿濫殺無辜,冷不聽

programme.title: 相思河畔
programme.desc: 富商之子馮琪偉戀上歌女方碧玉,碧玉身世凄涼,常受流氓頭子林老二及李老三壓榨勒索,幸得琪偉相助並娶之為妻。婚後二人育一子,惜李老三再度敲詐,最終琪偉為愛妻討回公道而與李老三同歸於盡

programme.title: 烏龍濟公
programme.desc: 「活佛」濟公與「呂祖」呂洞賓遊戲人間,因幾位凡間女子的命運交織而展開較量。兩位大仙各顯神通,展開三場荒誕離奇的跨界鬥法,在嬉笑怒罵間掀起連串風波。隨著風流韻事與人間情緣接連上演,一場令人啼笑皆非的曠世仙凡大戰也隨之展開

programme.title: 樑上君子
programme.desc: 本片為徐蝦導演。 董驃, 錢小豪及蔣金飾扒手, 惟董失手被捕; 董出獄後裝南洋闊客, 隨錢及蔣返家, 因為想扮相古怪, 惹途人圍觀, 三人乘機施妙手, 更向盤問的保安隊長羅莽自詡身份特殊, 使羅躬身謝罪

programme.title: 橘中戲
programme.desc: 一場驚心動魄的古代戰爭開始了,代表黑軍的少年將軍指揮步、馬、炮軍運籌帷幄,艱難的抵擋住了紅軍的強大攻勢,並通過奇襲的戰法攻入紅軍帥府,活捉老帥,取得了最後的勝利。n文化宮內,棋盤上,古代戰爭場面瞬間變成一盤象棋殘局,象棋大師陳文山無奈之下棄

programme.title: 銀杏之夢
programme.desc: 李小果和餘朵朵回老家舉行盛大的婚禮,婚宴後,正當大家觀賞他的電影處女作時,山上傳來了守林人報信的槍聲。秋葉幫著護林人樹根將偷樹賊抓住,卻得知小果是主謀。原來小果因為拍戲,欠下一大筆錢,為了還債出此下策。n小果躲了起來,朵朵心灰意冷卻不願傷害

programme.title: 溫哥華醬油樂隊
programme.desc: 從小就期待著去找媽媽和妹妹的蘇盼,帶著父親的臨終囑託,踏上了加拿大的尋親路。看望多年不見的媽媽安娜和孿生妹妹蘇瞳。n三人最初的相處十分尷尬。安娜無論如何也走不進兒子蘇盼的內心。叛逆的妹妹更對這個`陌生人不屑一顧。而蘇盼懷著對當年母親離

programme.title: 第五行動組III夜巴黎
programme.desc: 由於第五行動組的電臺遭到敵人破壞,楊勵和秋婷手中所掌握的敵人的資料無法送出。楊勵打聽到有艘法租界的船近日要離開上海,便找到當初曾幫他買過法租界通行證的小夥計,兩人相約晚上“夜巴黎見面。n可是,楊勵沒有想到真正的賣家即“夜巴黎的女主人竟然

programme.title: 狼牙山五壯士

野狗:與族群一起奔跑 #2
programme.desc: 氣溫上升意味著水越來越少,並使得大地充滿炎熱感曼茲族群必須與捕食性動物比鄰而立,依靠剩餘的珍貴水域補充水分與維卡群一起狩獵,餵養幼崽,並觀察鶴群如何在各種困難中茁壯成長

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境

programme.title: 阿拉斯加的夏天 英普
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加的夏天以令人驚嘆的高動態範圍成像方法拍攝,展現了美國最北部州份充滿活力的雄偉景緻從令人驚嘆的小灣,海灣和水灣所展示巴拉諾夫島的崎嶇之美,到座頭鯨和虎鯨在參天的冰川和高聳的山脈間那平靜的水域中暢遊的冰川灣,這是阿拉斯加與眾不同的旅程

programme.title: 奇異地球 #4 英普

programme.title: 野外紀事 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊

programme.desc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦

programme.title: 夏奇拉:新時代女性

programme.title: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: Banning its news feature in Australia, Facebook draws international condemnation But how does the social media giant regulate its content, in an era marked by insidious fake news? This alarming documentary offers unique undercover access to Facebook’s moderating hub It presents a disturbing picture of an organisation putting money before morality and for whom extreme content equals extreme profits

programme.title: Sky's The Limit
programme.desc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces

programme.title: Where The Light Shines
programme.desc: Afghanistan's first ski team reach for a brighter future Where the Light ShinesFrom their amateur efforts at home in the Bamyan peaks, Sajjad and Alishah have the chance to ski for Afghanistan in the Winter Olympics As local kids strap wood to their feet and imitate their heroes, the men face up to the difficulty of creating opportunities in a country that for generations has only seen war Filmed over four years, this beautiful film paints an uplifting and refreshing portrait of Afghanistan as you haven't seen it before

programme.title: Outbreak Onboard
programme.desc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first” Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free” The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:合意、興旺福音 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 美好的工作
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《美好的工作》。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-中華文明起源重溯與聖經創世記的關係
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#176粵
programme.desc: 溢及悅的母親王艷群突然回港，但無面目與子女相認，竟暗中偷看他倆的工作情況。她更化名「Mary 姨」，刻意接近溢。溢聽到慶與義的談話後，竟萌生要尋找親生母親的念頭，但悅怒責溢不應如此，兩姊弟竟因此鬧翻。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 鐵掌幫幫主遭黃蓉羞辱，最終對決時還竟以出恭為名逃跑。拖雷催促郭靖與華箏成親，黃藥師見狀氣極，黃蓉反過來維護郭靖。楊康靠丐幫信物被推舉成新幫主；郭靖黃蓉遇上淨衣派長老，雖懷疑對方圖謀不軌卻仍中邪術被困…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 「豬肉之最」是俗稱「第一刀」的豬頸背，到底它有多矜貴？且看肥媽示範「橙香第一刀」。魚香茄子煲令茄子煮得太腍，浪費其質感，肥媽可令茄子又爽又惹味。肥媽示範「娘惹海鮮醬燒鮫魚」及「老黃瓜花豆煲豬骨湯」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 有指不少Z世代受中至重度抑鬱情緒困擾，精神科醫生認為這群組多自幼接觸社交媒體，缺乏面對面社交溝通，故較容易產生孤獨感。醫生詳析不同抑鬱程度對生活的影響，如嚴重甚至有自殺風險。近年AI聊天技術興起，抑鬱人士若多與AI傾訴，對病情可有幫助？髖關節骨折患者多為長者，原因與骨質疏鬆相關，也可能引發肺炎、深層靜脈血栓等。骨科醫生提到此症的死亡率偏高，並帶來診治資訊。「睇餸食飯」，德哥示範「鹹菜涼瓜燜腩肉」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿、陳敏之第一晚請客，邀得愛下廚的龔嘉欣到臨。嘉欣不時在網上分享自家食譜，今集亦會展示拿手菜「乾燒大蝦」。諾懿擅長烹調海鮮，要輕鬆去除象拔蚌的內臟與外皮，有何秘訣？將蚌片放入上湯即焯即食，爽口鮮味！只要發揮創意，網紋哈密瓜也可變成可愛「飛天豬」，留意敏之示範。雞蛋看似平凡，卻能煮出千變萬化的滋味。諾懿巧手炮製「黃金蛋絲蝦球」，不單配菜講究，拉蛋絲的步驟亦有竅門！嘉欣另帶來零失敗的「鮮奶燉蛋」。

programme.title: 天梯#7粵
programme.desc: 濟民擔心世章，醫生說世章不會醒來，但新月不停呼喚下世章終醒來，在家人送別下離世，新月始知苗天是思行常說的好叔叔。世亮被販賣假犀角的騙子所騙，除客戶上門投訴，更有大批記者要求世亮交代出售假貨的事。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐有新的連身裙穿，小丸子大呼不公平，後來更趁姐姐不在時拿來偷穿，結果兩姊妹吵起上來。小丸子去做收音機體操，期間認識到一名自稱忍者後裔的老婦，聽她說完之後，小丸子對忍者產生濃厚興趣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 太空看似遙不可及，這集「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓卻指日常生活上有不少用品，例如攝影器材和床褥，都啟發自太空科技及相關研究？主持對太空人的生活與飲食充滿好奇，嘉賓提到太空食物盡量都以擠壓技術製作，讓太空人可於無重狀態下進食，亦不會「洩漏」食物。太空人又如何清潔身體及休息補眠？在太空書寫也要有合適工具，他帶來太空筆，並示範水中寫字。另外，嘉賓曾與登月太空人見面聊天，藉此明白到太空人背後所花的努力。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#23粵PG

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 有指不少Z世代受中至重度抑鬱情緒困擾，精神科醫生認為這群組多自幼接觸社交媒體，缺乏面對面社交溝通，故較容易產生孤獨感。醫生詳析不同抑鬱程度對生活的影響，如嚴重甚至有自殺風險。近年AI聊天技術興起，抑鬱人士若多與AI傾訴，對病情可有幫助？髖關節骨折患者多為長者，原因與骨質疏鬆相關，也可能引發肺炎、深層靜脈血栓等。骨科醫生提到此症的死亡率偏高，並帶來診治資訊。「睇餸食飯」，德哥示範「鹹菜涼瓜燜腩肉」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿、陳敏之第一晚請客，邀得愛下廚的龔嘉欣到臨。嘉欣不時在網上分享自家食譜，今集亦會展示拿手菜「乾燒大蝦」。諾懿擅長烹調海鮮，要輕鬆去除象拔蚌的內臟與外皮，有何秘訣？將蚌片放入上湯即焯即食，爽口鮮味！只要發揮創意，網紋哈密瓜也可變成可愛「飛天豬」，留意敏之示範。雞蛋看似平凡，卻能煮出千變萬化的滋味。諾懿巧手炮製「黃金蛋絲蝦球」，不單配菜講究，拉蛋絲的步驟亦有竅門！嘉欣另帶來零失敗的「鮮奶燉蛋」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 響螺烹調前先要去除多個內臟部位，諾懿示範箇中技巧，再用螺肝製作伴碟醬汁。雞蛋、鵪鶉蛋如何變成可愛雞仔？敏之巧手做出「一家大細」。嘉賓陳煒透露自五歲起開始入廚，更試過為二百人煮菜。她到來炮製豪華佳餚「西班牙紅蝦天使麵」，入味麵條配以「爆膏」紅蝦，好滋味！「龍躉兩味」也可變出非一般美味？諾懿炮製炸薑絲，伴以蒸龍躉一同享用。煒哥教煮自家刴椒醬，再運用熱石來烘香魚片，奉上一道既惹味又有氣勢的「桑拿魚」。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#19粵
programme.desc: 模型品牌EGO將舉辦全球宣傳活動，冠一致力爭取本地宣傳項目。前AI公司CEO Brian身敗名裂後轉戰玩具界，騙取大量EGO絕版模型，企圖藉舉辦玩具展牟暴利，卻遭網民揭發黑歷史。唐芯等人發現該網民正是小棧住客楊光，原來他亦是苦主之一。眾人聯手聲討Brian，Brian卻反發律師信，擬控告楊光誹謗。唐芯設法蒐集Brian罪證，行動中卻生變故。另一邊廂，楊帆竟與Brian合作，答應幫他對付唐芯等人……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#24粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如縱記起車禍當晚經過，惜看不清司機容貌。啟榮暗中派人跟蹤幸如、家謙。曉彤獲苓君協助，取得加入東馹董事局競選主席的資格，但這意味她要與家謙提早完婚。幸如終恍然某事的真相，大受衝擊；雖然如此，幸如仍對這事心存感恩……繼威向雪文示好，雪文以為繼威知錯，詎料……幸如看不過眼苓君擺弄家人以至自己的人生，當眾直斥其非……

programme.title: 百花殺#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 黨爭落敗，顧家全族被誅，唯一倖存者信王妃顧青梔飲下毒酒，以命為餌讓范家陪葬。昭寧郡主沈汐和赴京為太后賀壽並接受指婚，卻被推入水中，在幻境中與青梔相遇…太子蕭華雍意外救下汐和，青梔後在汐和身體中醒來…

programme.title: 玄戰直播粵PG
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

究竟天有幾高#1粵
programme.desc: 二零一零年，大學教授榮杰帶領的香港科研團隊，要為「嫦娥三號」研發相機指向系統，他發現學生張寧對航天研究充滿熱誠，遂邀她加入團隊。團隊終於完成任務，成員們開心不已。團隊及後要為嫦娥五號開發表面採樣的裝置，張寧埋首研發之際，好友王志強、文世賢、張春生卻因不同理由離開團隊，令張寧陷入迷惘……二零二零年，嫦娥五號即將升空，張寧跟榮杰一同見證歷史。她的三位好友縱沒有參與其中，仍為團隊的成功大感雀躍。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 開學前後，手足口病的傳染風險會增加，這病主要透過飛沫、分泌物傳播，要留意手掌和腳掌可有紅疹，或口唇附近出現紅點。兒科醫生提醒除病徵外，家長亦要注意小朋友的精神狀態，治療這病則以舒緩不適為主。未有文字前，繩結可用作記事，其後卻漸發展為藝術，而每個繩結都附帶不同祝福。繩結藝術家細談初學時遇到的困難，並即場示範綁出「吉祥結」。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨炮製「催淚辣椒皮蛋醬拌麵」，辣度可隨嗜辣程度調製。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 響螺烹調前先要去除多個內臟部位，諾懿示範箇中技巧，再用螺肝製作伴碟醬汁。雞蛋、鵪鶉蛋如何變成可愛雞仔？敏之巧手做出「一家大細」。嘉賓陳煒透露自五歲起開始入廚，更試過為二百人煮菜。她到來炮製豪華佳餚「西班牙紅蝦天使麵」，入味麵條配以「爆膏」紅蝦，好滋味！「龍躉兩味」也可變出非一般美味？諾懿炮製炸薑絲，伴以蒸龍躉一同享用。煒哥教煮自家刴椒醬，再運用熱石來烘香魚片，奉上一道既惹味又有氣勢的「桑拿魚」。

programme.title: 天梯#8粵
programme.desc: 世亮耐不住壓力留書出走。苗天說出販賣假犀角的騙子之事，新月指坤堯安排一切害世亮。濟民表示要聘請鄭嬌、廣達及三斤。愛娣帶醉流連，被流氓施暴。美娟服藥後咳出血被送入院。坤堯父子到賀家，當眾提出分家。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#177粵
programme.desc: 悅驚見溢新相識的朋友「Mary姨」正是她親生母親群。悅和群不欲在溢前發難，扮作互不相識。悅暗中要群放棄接近溢。悅往找慶及朋商量，慶認為群此番回港必另有所圖，更要二人保守秘密，卻因此被躲在一旁的麗聽到。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#22粵普
programme.desc: 楊康當著丐幫長老們的面求娶穆念慈，準備接任幫主之位後與穆念慈成親。丐幫大會上，楊康誣衊黃蓉和郭靖是殺害洪七公的兇手，二人被點了啞穴，無力反駁。此時，裘千仞受完顏洪烈所託，帶來了金銀珠寶，希望丐幫南下。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫以故事形式介紹嘉賓JW王灝兒、梁釗峰、關楚耀與On仔（陳健安），Do姐可會收貨？曼谷的女化妝師擅長甚麼妝容？揭曉答案時還加映胡慧冲特別演出！來到「試食題」，名廚巧製「有營芝士餅」，究竟加入甚麼食材？楚耀和On仔藉「大大貼士」成功搶分，提示有多明顯？東京的監獄病院餐廳內，疑似肝臟的食品用甚麼製成？兌換環節，釗峰竟稱四個地方「各有鞦韆」；隊友JW更公開二人「親密聯繫」，引來連環笑聲！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫發揮創意介紹今集嘉賓陳山聰、陳敏之，總算得到Do姐的「OK」評級。「問題專員」陳雅思拜訪「濟州石敢當」，傳說觸摸石像某部位可保健康？巴黎一部「特大自助洗衣機」原來另有玄機！Do姐說出「洗衣機沒有電子裝置」的沒用貼士，對兩隊可有啟發？台北的「一人餐廳」在餐桌上放着一款牙醫工具，卻並非放進口中，究竟得物何所用？山聰與敏之帶着相同積分進入兌換獎金環節，但最終出現天堂與地獄的結果！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 各人害怕悅破壞，要溢送群離開。悅趕回家看不到群，當眾向溢大興問罪，令溢終於知道「Mary姨」正是其母。悅數落群時，慶卻突然說出群遺棄兒女的原因。群終於與子女重圓，但群突然向溢提出，請他一起到美國生活。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 黃蓉為了證明自己是洪七公親傳的弟子，她用打狗棒法教訓楊康，彭長老等人提出如果黃蓉用打狗棒法打敗他們，他們就承認她的幫主身分；黃蓉和郭靖來到鐵掌幫，看到完顏洪烈已來到，決定先去鐵掌中峰取走《武穆遺書》…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 梁嘉琪、黃心穎、麥美恩、湯洛雯、張秀文大鬧肥媽廚房，肥媽以「辣酒蟶子」、「胡椒雞煲」、「鱷魚肉川貝螺頭湯」塞住五位「是非精」的嘴巴！肥媽的「法國蝸牛」一張「紅衫魚」有找？「燉雪裡紅」又是甚麼菜式？

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡覺時身體突然抖動或雙腳抽搐，可能是出現「睡眠相關運動障礙」。精神科醫生以睡眠週期解說狀況，成因主要是腦部鐵質不足？醫生細述有關症狀對健康的影響，並帶來治療資訊。入住兒童之家的小孩各有狀況，「同行大使」關心妍與兒童之家院長合辦音樂會，為孩子送上關懷，而心妍的女兒更會「擔大旗」帶領小朋友唱歌！心妍與主持黃劍文率先預演，在節目中合唱<陪著你走。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製家常小菜「XO醬涼瓜烙」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 「芝士龍蝦伊麵」味道與賣相兼備，諾懿提到龍蝦下鑊前要先插入竹籤，以免龍蝦肉變彎。他自製芝士醬有何秘訣？敏之示範在方包畫上花朵，將平凡食材變得賞心悅目！新一代「美女廚神」張曦雯登場，她擅長煮西餐，並選用三文魚扒及煙三文魚奉上「法式三文魚芝士派」。中、西式煮雞的做法層出不窮，諾懿以先煙燻、後氣炸的方式帶來「甕窯風味雞」。曦雯用雞胸肉炮製「意大利芝士焗釀雞脯」，身為「芝士控」的她原來對健康定義另有見解？

programme.title: 天梯#9粵
programme.desc: 苗天看見坤堯逼新月，美娟取出一封信公開坤堯的惡行，坤堯中風入院。世豪跪求美娟放過坤堯，美娟表示坤堯不再提出分家便不追究。新月發現苗天給世章寫的借據，頓感一線曙光。苗天往找新月，但新月卻到濟民藥行找他。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 由於測驗分數欠佳，小丸子在媽媽安排下，參加暑假補習堂。雖然小丸子起初興致缺缺，但代課老師卻令她超乎想像，她為人溫柔之餘，連藤木的勞作功課也細心指導，小丸子與藤木很快就喜歡上她，可是……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 曾在外國生活的Emily姐姐，憶述在公園見到松鼠跳來跳去，非常得意，子健哥哥隨即提議這集「Artspiration」齊齊畫可愛松鼠。松鼠特徵要捉緊，手細小但大腿粗壯，尾巴所佔的比例亦較大。上色時不妨發揮更多創意，予看畫者一絲驚喜。學校小息時間雖短，但學生們可以做很多自己喜歡的事，「開心SHARE」以此為主題，收集各位小朋友的快樂時光。談起學校的獎勵機制，某主持興之所至，突擊向拍檔們提問兩條IQ題。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 新敵人不僅有風花堇師姐，還有她的妹妹風花莉莉。尊敬的師姐竟會在愛麗絲比亞搗亂，奪取女生的音樂之力，阿源對這個事實深感沮喪。正當大家想安慰阿源，立志成為煙花師傅、流星的同班同學諸星麻音走來搭話。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.desc: (大結局)幸如記起當天撞傷自己之人是誰，更懷疑對方的目標其實是家謙。啟榮不忿苓君始終偏袒家謙；不料苓君此時受傷昏迷，啟榮趁機加快部署。雪文想起曾拍到幸如被車撞的片段，欲以此跟家謙要錢。繼威則欲搶走影片換錢還債，追逐中，雪文撞傷昏迷……幸如終取得影片準備報警，卻得知家謙與曉彤被綁架！幸如依指示前往綁架地點，希望可救出二人，但家謙不知所蹤……

programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
母親的乒乓球#1粵
programme.desc: 女童余卓穎於乒乓球教練郭一指導下，接連在館內賽勝出。卓穎不擅面對逆境，一次球賽落敗大受打擊，及後又與同伴起衝突而被郭一訓斥，她意氣下聲言不再打乒乓球。江芷昕跟女兒卓穎相依為命，本想開解卓穎，卻產生磨擦，讓芷昕反思母女之間缺乏溝通。郭一提出讓卓穎擔任一日導師，為芷昕進行乒乓球特訓，藉以幫助卓穎衝破心理障礙。特訓過後，母女修補關係，卓穎也重拾正確心態，再次於館內賽取勝，並得到與國家青年隊切磋的機會。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡覺時身體突然抖動或雙腳抽搐，可能是出現「睡眠相關運動障礙」。精神科醫生以睡眠週期解說狀況，成因主要是腦部鐵質不足？醫生細述有關症狀對健康的影響，並帶來治療資訊。入住兒童之家的小孩各有狀況，「同行大使」關心妍與兒童之家院長合辦音樂會，為孩子送上關懷，而心妍的女兒更會「擔大旗」帶領小朋友唱歌！心妍與主持黃劍文率先預演，在節目中合唱<陪著你走。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製家常小菜「XO醬涼瓜烙」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 「芝士龍蝦伊麵」味道與賣相兼備，諾懿提到龍蝦下鑊前要先插入竹籤，以免龍蝦肉變彎。他自製芝士醬有何秘訣？敏之示範在方包畫上花朵，將平凡食材變得賞心悅目！新一代「美女廚神」張曦雯登場，她擅長煮西餐，並選用三文魚扒及煙三文魚奉上「法式三文魚芝士派」。中、西式煮雞的做法層出不窮，諾懿以先煙燻、後氣炸的方式帶來「甕窯風味雞」。曦雯用雞胸肉炮製「意大利芝士焗釀雞脯」，身為「芝士控」的她原來對健康定義另有見解？

programme.title: 天梯#9粵
programme.desc: 苗天看見坤堯逼新月，美娟取出一封信公開坤堯的惡行，坤堯中風入院。世豪跪求美娟放過坤堯，美娟表示坤堯不再提出分家便不追究。新月發現苗天給世章寫的借據，頓感一線曙光。苗天往找新月，但新月卻到濟民藥行找他。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#178粵
programme.desc: 各人害怕悅破壞，要溢送群離開。悅趕回家看不到群，當眾向溢大興問罪，令溢終於知道「Mary姨」正是其母。悅數落群時，慶卻突然說出群遺棄兒女的原因。群終於與子女重圓，但群突然向溢提出，請他一起到美國生活。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 黃蓉為了證明自己是洪七公親傳的弟子，她用打狗棒法教訓楊康，彭長老等人提出如果黃蓉用打狗棒法打敗他們，他們就承認她的幫主身分；黃蓉和郭靖來到鐵掌幫，看到完顏洪烈已來到，決定先去鐵掌中峰取走《武穆遺書》…

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 貂蟬的眼淚威力顛覆三國，她向黎芷珊大爆自己在三國時代有千千萬萬個「分身」！康熙遺詔上「康熙傳位十四子」與「康熙傳位于四子」之爭，令宮中謠言四起，「大鑊密探凌凌一」找到宮中知情人士大爆雍正登基的內幕！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 西施令吳王夫差神魂顛倒，最終助越王勾踐反敗為勝，她是怎樣從重口味的鄉下妹變成美麗的天后？慈禧太后曾九道上諭要徹查「楊乃武與小白菜」案，究竟一宗婆媳糾紛如何演變成奪命血案？CID兵分三路破解冤案真相！

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎(完)
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.desc: The Gang dives headfirst into the Fear Zone - and it’s pure chaos. With Nightmare Mode activated and the Fear Bomb ticking, only faith can light the way.

programme.desc: With 60 seconds left, the Fear Bomb ticks toward doom. Kungfuda and God's Gang fight with faith and love - will light prevail or fear win?

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Alien Mayhem! | Episode 1, 2, 3
programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: The Boy Who Wants To Live
programme.desc: 70-year-old Willi catches Malian refugee Nama stealing, but decides not to report him. Having been a refugee once, Willi sees a part of himself in Nama, and brings him home. However, Nama’s decision further frays his relationship with his son.

programme.title: Wonderfully Beautiful
programme.desc: Ranging from a 60-year-old retiree who no longer finds herself desirable to a daughter trying to make her breakthrough as a model, five women of different ages confront their self-image and the expectation they have for themselves and the people around them.

programme.title: Lucky Girl
programme.desc: TV star Nina Sokil is diagnosed with bone cancer, but deeming her career to be more important with her health, Nina goes to absurd lengths to hide her condition so that she keeps working.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: Breathless
programme.desc: In an illegal arms case, three men, including two policemen, are dead. Mattheisen reveals a radical right-wing conspiracy, and suspects a mole. However, he is shot dead with Inspector Dorn’s weapon, while Dorn is found at the crime scene with no memory.

programme.title: A Butterfly's Heart
programme.desc: Juozapas is a quiet boy who cultivates insects in an abandoned house. He has a big bulge under his weird sweater and the school’s tough kids call him “balloon”. Rugilè moves to town and becomes Juozapas’ friend. She is the first to discover his secret.

programme.title: What's for Dinner, Mom?
programme.desc: Sisters Tae and Yo return to their childhood home and discover a box of recipes and letters from their late Japanese mother. As Tae uncovers her mother’s hidden struggles, she journeys to Taiwan to retrace her past through memory and food.

programme.title: The Odd-Job Men
programme.desc: A week in the life of Moha, Valero and Pep - workers in a small plumbing and electricity company in the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. Moha is on a one-week trial period and is set to replace Pep, but Valero doesn't think he has what it takes.

programme.title: The Cave Of The Yellow Dog
programme.desc: Nansal, a Mongolian nomadic girl finds a puppy and brings it home but her father believes it to be bad luck. But when the dog saves the family’s baby, he finally accepts it. Central to this tale is the belief in the cycle of rebirth between man and dog.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: A Little Bit Of Freedom
programme.desc: Haunted by a missing boy's case from 14 years ago, Helen Dorn recently discovers a lead linking to the alleged perpetrator, Ron Faber. Dorn immediately heads for Hamburg when she learns that Faber was apprehended with a deceased Chinese boy in his van.

programme.title: Irreplaceable
programme.desc: Jean-Pierre Werner, a revered and devoted country doctor, discovers that he is suffering from an inoperable tumor. As a doctor from the city arrives to help him with his practice, Werner is troubled by the thought that he is no longer irreplaceable.

programme.title: Khutulun: The Wrestling Princess
programme.desc: Princess Khutulun, a formidable Mongol warrior descended from Genghis Khan, has her marriage ambushed by an assassin who steals the Golden Sutra. Vowing revenge, Khutulun and her clan set out on an epic journey to retrieve the sacred text and restore peace.

programme.desc: During the oppressive Chilean dictatorship, a lonely model maker takes refuge in the apparent peace of his neighborhood. However, his life is upended when mysterious neighbors arrive, unleashing a spiral of horror and violence that will leave deep scars.

programme.title: Mr. K
programme.desc: Mr. K, a traveling magician, finds himself in a Kafkaesque nightmare when he can’t find the exit of the hotel, he has slept in. His attempts to get out only pull him deeper, entangling him further with the hotel and its curious inhabitants.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Machu Picchu, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to the ancient Peruvian city of Machu Picchu to watch Kyan compete in the Inca Trail Marathon. It accidentally gets a blast from Glitch's size ray and grows to gigantic proportions. Another Grimbot pulls a lever and the monster robot slips through the front hatch, tumbling towards the ruins below.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.desc: Little artichoke sings about being the rhyming queen.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Evil Pea's Party Plan
programme.desc: It's Evil Pea's birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it's too late!

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Picnic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a very special picnic together. Lots of Tubby Toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Boat
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say boat and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different boats; a boat that's big, a boat that's small, and even a boat you can stick on the wall! There's a paddle boat, a puddle boat, a rocking boat and a find-it-in-your-Christmas-stocking boat! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - A Touch of Sock
programme.desc: OKIDO's biggest robot Stan Tall has no sense of touch and is longing to feel the snow and the wind on his face. Will Messy and his friends be able to help?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - It Came From Planet Boogie
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can't stop dancing?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

The constellation gives Gran Gran an idea - they can have a sleepover plan to go stargazing in the garden. What can they spot in the night sky? Are there more constellations to find? And can Great-Gran Gran see the same stars in the sky?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Imagination Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels tell Duggee that they have nothing left to play with, he encourages them to use their imagination.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Machu Picchu, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to the ancient Peruvian city of Machu Picchu to watch Kyan compete in the Inca Trail Marathon. In the skies above, Grandmaster Glitch tries to fix his Grimbot when a loose spring causes it to bounce about inside Grim HQ like a children's toy. It accidentally gets a blast from Glitch's size ray and grows to gigantic proportions. Another Grimbot pulls a lever and the monster robot slips through the front hatch, tumbling towards the ruins below.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S01 - Artichoke
programme.desc: Little artichoke sings about being the rhyming queen.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Evil Pea's Party Plan
programme.desc: It's Evil Pea's birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Sweetieland Saga
programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it's too late!

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Honk Honk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - House
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say house and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different houses; a small house, a tall house and a hen house! There's a lighthouse, a bright house, a bee house and a tree house. And of course, the most important house of all, 'My house!' The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Messy Has a Hoot
programme.desc: Messy and his friends go on a camping trip in OKIDO Forest with Tweedie the Explorer and meet a few more nocturnal animals than they bargained for.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Breakdown Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan the ferry can't shut his engine off, so he's speeding out of control around the lake. How will Mojo and Bo get aboard to take control and steer Bryan to safety?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

He loses control of the Grimbler and is sent flying across the academy, out of control. Lars leads the Go Jetters into action by giving chase across land and sea in the their all-a

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Muffin Cone
programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of ‘scaffolding kung fu”.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The 82 Tenants

Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber(1977)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.
